learning_outcomes.text: Select suitable fluid energy machines for a wide variety of technical applications.
Perform design and project planning of pumps, compressors, turbomachines, and reciprocating machines.
Gain a deeper insight into modern turbomachinery for energy generation, such as gas and steam turbines, as well as wind turbines and water turbines.
Make planning decisions based on evaluation criteria.

syllabus_topics: Operating behavior and characteristic maps of turbomachines
Special aspects, structure, and functioning of selected turbomachines:
Gas turbines, steam turbines, water turbines, wind turbines
Classification and structure of positive displacement machines
Structure, functioning, and operating characteristics of commonly used machine types
Students discuss and evaluate technical system solutions for practical engineering applications and find optimal solutions.
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the written examination (grade). Participation in practical courses is a prerequisite for taking the exam. The weighting of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
